scope: Degree-shift node classification on citation graphs comparing single-parameter scaling against multi-stage architectures
coverage_limits: Bounded offline verification campaign covering OpenAlex and arXiv query families.
next_check: Confirm held-out degree-shift split results across 5 fixed random seeds before publication claims.

evidence.claim: Standard 2-layer GCN loses 6.8 macro-F1 points under tail-degree shift while multi-stage attention stacks are not ablated against single-parameter degree scaling.

closest_works.difference: Prior work evaluates a 4-module pipeline without ablating single-parameter degree-aware L2 scaling.

candidates.claim: Whether a single degree-aware L2 scaling factor closes the tail-degree shift gap without multi-stage attention or auxiliary losses remains untested.
candidates.rationale: Full-text inspection shows prior multi-module proposals omit single-parameter degree-scaling ablations on fixed degree-shift splits.
candidates.consequence: If a single scaling parameter matches the 4-module stack, the extra 3 modules can be removed.
candidates.answer_path: Matched 5-seed ablation comparing tuned 2-layer GCN, 1-parameter degree scaling, and stacked modules.
